thread:
maya.k: Quick async check — status on Optimize toolkit handoff? Need a short list of owners + next milestone before Friday.

samir.p: owning quant recs + regression alerts. Goal: public PR with profiles by Thu EOD.

ali-r: taking batching/caching suggestions. Working on perf matrix for 4 sequence lengths, ETA Wed.

jonah: eng-infra is blocked on kernel validation for the new q4f16 path — low-priority GPUs currently have flaky kernels. Pinged infra-sig.

caroline.t: docs/devex needs final callouts for config flags and example `server.config` snippet. Can you drop that in a PR branch?

maya.k: @samir.p @ali-r add a 2-line ownership blurb here (who merges, who notifies customers). Also include rollback playbook if we see perf regressions.

samir.p: ownership: samir.p merges quant profiles -> notif to #support + release-notes. Backup owner: jonah if I'm OOO. Rollback: revert profile, switch routing policy to `fallback=fast` for affected routes.

ali-r: ownership: ali-r merges batching configs -> run smoke job `optkit-smoke` in prod-staging, then tag release. Rollback: revert batching flag, set `min_batch=1` for 30m.

jonah: infra update: kernel vendor fixed a race in RC3; we have validation run scheduled 02:00 UTC tomorrow. If it passes, we can land q4f16. If not, fallback is q8-awq for now.

caroline.t: PR template for docs posted: link: https://stash.redwood/optimize/docs-pr (will add example `server.config` sections).

maya.k: quick ask — can someone run a targeted eval on prompt set `billing-templates` once batching set to 32? We saw a small hallucination uptick last time.

qa-bot: AUTO: regression alert filed -> OPTKIT-432. Bucket: hallucination-suspects. Assigned to samir.p.

samir.p: got it, will run eval sweep overnight and post summary. If pass, merge quant profiles + batching. If fail, escalate to product for quality threshold decision.

engops-bot: REMINDER: scheduled canary start at 2026-06-02T02:30Z for route `/generate/optkit` (canary size 5%).

maya.k: Action items summary — assign owners here so I can close the loop:
- samir.p: quant profiles + regression sweep (PR + tests) — due Thu EOD
- ali-r: batching/caching perf matrix + PR — due Wed
- jonah: kernel validation & fallback plan — update by tomorrow
- caroline.t: docs PR with config snippet — due Thu AM
- qa-bot / samir.p: run billing-templates eval after batching applied

Please reply with any changes. :white_check_mark:

caroline.t: acked, will add the config example and a short migration section.

ali-r: acked, will also include perf numbers for batch sizes 8/16/32.

jonah: if validation passes I'll flip the kernel flag and notify ops. If it fails, I'll open a rollback ticket and escalate.

samir.p: one note — I want to try a tiny prefix cache tweak before full batching: set `prefix_cache_ttl=60s` in staging to reduce false positives. Will include in PR.

maya.k: perfect. I'll consolidate these into the central project board and ping sales/customer success for heads-up. Thanks everyone.
